from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np

from rcb_traj import Session


OUT = Path("/app/output")
INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"


def main():
    s = Session("place_object_stand", instance=INSTANCE)
    try:
        from envs.utils import ArmTag

        env = s.env
        arm = ArmTag("right" if env.object.get_pose().p[0] > 0 else "left")
        print("initial", s.status())
        print("object", env.object.get_name(), env.object.get_pose().p)
        print("stand", env.displaystand.get_pose().p,
              "top", env.displaystand.get_functional_point(0, "list"))
        print("arm", arm)

        s.record_start()
        grasp = env.grasp_actor(env.object, arm, pre_grasp_dis=0.10, grasp_dis=0.0)
        print("grasp plan", env.move(grasp), "plan_success", env.plan_success)
        print("after grasp", env.object.get_pose().p,
              "ee", env.get_arm_pose(arm), "gripper", env.robot.get_right_gripper_val())

        # The stand's functional point marks its top center. The object's model
        # origin is its support point, so align that origin to the stand point.
        placement = env.place_actor(
            env.object,
            arm,
            env.displaystand.get_functional_point(0, "list"),
            pre_dis=0.12,
            dis=0.025,
            is_open=True,
            constrain="align",
            align_axis=[1, 0, 0],
            actor_axis=[1, 0, 0],
        )
        print("place plan", env.move(placement), "plan_success", env.plan_success)
        print("after place", env.object.get_pose().p,
              "stand", env.displaystand.get_pose().p)

        # Ensure both grippers satisfy the task predicate.
        env.move(env.open_gripper(ArmTag("left")))
        if arm == "left":
            env.move(env.open_gripper(ArmTag("right")))

        actions = s.record_stop()
        print("recorded", actions.shape, "final", s.status())
        replay = s.replay(actions)
        print("replay", replay, "object", env.object.get_pose().p,
              "stand", env.displaystand.get_pose().p)
        if not replay["success"]:
            raise RuntimeError("recorded trajectory did not pass the task predicate")
        s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / "trajectory.npz", meta={"arm": str(arm)})
        print("saved", OUT / "trajectory.npz")
    finally:
        s.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
